attributes.action: Require Parliament to review and vote again on the Defence Investment Plan
attributes.additional_details: The Defence Investment Plan involves significant public expenditure and long-term strategic decisions. Parliament should have the opportunity to examine the Plan’s assumptions, costs, risks and expected outcomes to ensure it delivers value for money and meets the UK’s current defence needs.
attributes.background: We want Parliament to conduct a fresh review of the Defence Investment Plan and hold a new vote on its priorities, funding commitments and implementation timetable.

rejection.details: This petition was submitted before the 2026 DIP was published so we are now in a different landscape - there has been quite a lot of time in the House dedicated to the new DIP and the Defence Committee is holding public evidence sessions on it. We do not know what you think would be the purpose of looking at the previous DIP.
